04 / IDEAS & EXPLORATION

Some “what ifs”
deserve a prototype.

Business questions, financial technology, and ideas I’m taking apart to see whether there is anything worth building inside.

Working hypotheses. Open to a good counterargument.

01

FINANCIAL DATA / RESEARCH

Connect the company.
Then question the signal.

+

Can connecting issuers across identifiers and news create a more useful starting point for financial research?

The experiment

A financial entity intelligence and event-signal pipeline using accessible public data. Start with identity, provenance, and a small reproducible research question.

What has to earn its place

The quality of the links, whether the signal survives sensible testing, and whether the result helps someone make a better-informed decision.

EXPLORATION · NOT A RELEASED PROJECT
02

FINANCIAL AI / PRODUCT THINKING

A research copilot that
can show its working.

+

What would make an AI research assistant worth trusting beyond its ability to sound helpful?

The experiment

A narrow research workflow that links claims back to documents, flags uncertainty, and gives the person reviewing it a clear place to intervene.

The business question

Which part of the workflow improves? Does it reduce effort without quietly increasing verification work or moving the risk somewhere harder to see?

WORKING HYPOTHESIS
03

BUSINESS / LEARNING SYSTEMS

From an ambitious roadmap
to Tuesday’s actual work.

+

A plan has to survive an ordinary week to be useful. What would make a learning system help someone follow through?

The experiment

A focused Notion system that connects a direction, a few active actions, evidence of learning, and a weekly review.

The product question

Can someone adapt it quickly and keep using it after the initial burst of enthusiasm? The template should have a job beyond looking organised.
